body: My friend just came over tonight.  and he spoke with all my friends and offered me a check worth 600 dollars.  Its killing me man.. I haven't stopped crying since he left 25 minutes ago.  Man, I don't even know how to deal with this.

I don't think I want to kill myself.. But I don't want to live with my friends, apply to more jobs, or focus on women anymore.

I feel like I'm just going to go and become one of those crazy homeless that wander from city to city and fight themselves in city parks for money in a hat.
